deadline.value: Applications for Fall 2027 are due January 6, 2027, which is also the date all reference letters must arrive; late applications may be considered.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall 2027 is Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

gre_general.value: The department no longer accepts General or Physics GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Astronomy and Astrophysics department no longer accepts General or Physics GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is not accepted.
gre_subject.quote: No, the Astronomy and Astrophysics department no longer accepts either General or Physics GRE scores.

supervisor.value: No faculty endorsement or research opening is needed; admission and support do not depend on any adviser.
supervisor.quote: Neither a student's admission nor the department's commitment to financial support after matriculation is tied to any particular adviser's endorsement or financial resources.

also.quote: Students are not assigned advisers by the department, and many students change advisers or work with multiple advisers.

funding.value: All entering students are guaranteed support (tuition waiver and stipend through a fellowship, TA or RA) while in good academic standing.
funding.quote: All entering students are guaranteed support.

also.quote: Typically, first year students are awarded teaching assistantships and full tuition is waived.

entry_route.value: Everyone applies directly to the PhD, whether they hold a bachelor's or a higher degree.
entry_route.quote: No, all applicants should apply directly to the Ph.D. program, whether they have an (anticipated) bachelor’s degree or higher degree.

fee_waiver.value: A waiver is possible only for financial hardship, by emailing the chair of graduate admissions with a CV.
fee_waiver.quote: If it presents a financial hardship, you are welcome to apply for a fee waiver by contacting the chair of graduate admissions

notes: Department page quotes a $65 fee while the Graduate School lists $85 for international applicants, so no department fee is set. Department TOEFL guidance (105 favoured, speaking 19) uses the old scale.
